verdict.rationale: Recruitee's own support docs say users can "create and manage" hiring pipelines per job opening, and its features page lists "Applicant management & pipeline", so the core configurable-pipeline capability is first-party. Beyond that, the evidence is only headline-level and none of the story's specific mechanics are shown. Missing for 10: documented custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates between stages, bulk actions across the pipeline, in-depth pipeline docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Create and manage your job openings, hiring pipelines, and application forms
